# Set volume (`audio.volume`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Audio · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Sets the master volume of an output device.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `level` | whole number (0–100) | yes |  | Volume in percent. |
| `device` | text | no |  | Part of the device name as shown in Sound settings (e.g. Headphones, Speakers, USB). Leave empty for the current default device. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: audio.volume
    level: 30
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `device` is the same.
